recommended_human_sequence: Fill only human_value_to_enter and optional notes_for_human in the 10-row CSV.
Run template preflight and end-to-end dry run.
Request separate import approval only if checks pass.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must name who owns the support-contact decision or the approved internal owner reference.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: role, team, or person reference explicitly approved by a human
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject blank-looking placeholders, guessed owners, or direct personal phone/email not meant for public config.
guidance_rows.example_placeholder: EXAMPLE_ONLY: support owner role reviewed by human
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Prefer internal role or approved owner reference; avoid raw personal contact details.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must point to a human-reviewable internal source for the owner/contact decision.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: internal ticket, meeting note, document path, or approval reference
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject unsupported personal contact data, vague memory, or unapproved public contact claims.
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Use a reference ID or internal document name instead of private phone/email.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must be a concrete date or an explicit reviewed date source.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: YYYY-MM-DD or explicit reviewed date reference
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject vague dates such as soon, later, next week, or guessed current date.
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Date only; no personal details required.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must say whether the owner acknowledged scope, and point to the human review source.
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject unsupported approved claims, production-ready claims, or customer-facing launch claims.
guidance_rows.example_placeholder: EXAMPLE_ONLY: hold - scope not yet approved by owner
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Reference the review record; do not expose private discussion details.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must identify the human approval evidence source without claiming execution.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: approval record, meeting note, ticket, or signed-off internal reference
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject verbal-only claims with no reference, or claims that approval equals launch.
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Use record identifiers; avoid copying private messages.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must identify who reviewed the entry at a human-readable level.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: reviewer role, team, person name, or internal reviewer reference
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject anonymous approval, guessed names, or unapproved personal contact details.
guidance_rows.example_placeholder: EXAMPLE_ONLY: reviewer role or internal reviewer reference
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Use role/reference if public names are not approved for config.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must be the actual human review date or a traceable date reference.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: YYYY-MM-DD or explicit reviewed date reference
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject vague dates such as today, soon, later, or guessed current date.
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Date only; no personal details required.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must describe the selected support-contact channel type without pretending it is live.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: approved channel type or internal reference, such as support_email_candidate, ticketing_system_candidate, or hold_no_channel_approved
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject live public contact claims, production support claims, or customer-ready language if not separately approved.
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Do not expose real addresses or forms until the channel is approved.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must summarize the human decision while preserving hold/not-production-ready boundaries.
guidance_rows.accepted_value_shape: concise human decision summary with boundary-safe wording
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject production-ready, customer-validated, launched, or universal support claims.
guidance_rows.example_placeholder: EXAMPLE_ONLY: support channel decision remains on hold pending owner approval
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Summarize the decision, not private deliberation.

guidance_rows.quality_rule: Must state whether abuse handling is defined and cite the human-review source.
guidance_rows.reject_if: Reject unsupported live support, incident response, production-ready, or customer-support claims.
guidance_rows.example_placeholder: EXAMPLE_ONLY: hold - abuse handling path not yet approved
guidance_rows.privacy_note: Reference the process record; do not expose private escalation contacts.
